# Frozen pre-capability Save V6 wire fixtures

Profile baseline: c571fb164164b46cde5dda4cbdbdb94f4a708bba (no effectSourcesVersion).

`legacy-empty.json`, `legacy-authored-air-step.json`, `legacy-clockworks.json`, and
`legacy-v4.json` are byte copies of persisted, pre-change runtime-test save files.
They were frozen before compiling the capability-source migration. The other files
are static, independently authored old-wire variants of that captured V6 object,
including literal equipment/bloodline source records from the frozen baseline.
They are not generated by the new SaveV6 serializer or by the new resolver.

The matrix covers all six grants, selected/unselected Map and Acoustic Mapping,
empty selection, equipment plus bloodline, unknown lineage, route provenance,
non-default regeneration config, private clocks/fraction/request ledger, inventory,
Pump/Clockworks state and exploration. The slot uses unchanged schema 3. V5/V4
fixtures exercise their independent migration routes. Tests never rewrite fixtures.

Baseline verification: all four captures, all twelve matrix rows, the slot wrapper,
V5 and V4 passed two tests against a separate, unchanged c571 runtime-check copy.
The source files in that copy were byte-compared to the old harness and their Git
blob IDs matched the pinned c571 source manifest. Verification log and SHA-256
fixture/source manifest are retained with the migration evidence. The new profile
reader was not used for that acceptance check.
